title.narrative: NGO "YouthUp": "Sexual Education Based on Human Rights Approach"
NGO "YouthUp": "Sexual Education Based on Human Rights Approach"

description.narrative: The project promotes comprehensive sexual education through a rights-based, inclusive approach, focusing on continued professional development for youth workers, educators, and youth spaces previously trained under the SexUp program. It aims to establish a new educational framework integrating sexual education, gender equality, and diversity within a broader human rights context. Main activities include a Training of Trainers program, development of a board game on a gender equality and SexEd, strategic consultations for youth centers. Expected results include a new methodology, 25 trained educators, strengthened capacity of 10 youth centers, and outreach to over 10000 young people across Ukraine.
